status: protocol fixed before holdout evaluation; code construction and calibration are development stages
matrix_design: PEG column-weight-three base at m=150; deterministic largest-check splitting yields nested row rates .15:.025:.9, check degrees >=2
rate_selection: smallest calibrated row rate whose Wilson 95% upper FER is <=.01; require all higher tested rates to pass; separate pooled/shrink policies; no holdout retuning
strong_baseline: BP plus full order-one ordered-statistics postprocessing on nonconvergence, same channel LLR score and budget for all priors
shrinkage: p_z=p_pool+w*(E_z/S_z-E/S), w=max(0,1-v/d^2), v=p_pool*(1-p_pool)*(1/S_r+1/S_d), d=E_d/S_d-E_r/S_r; w=0 for missing classes or d=0

channel_control.noise: one basis-independent depolarizing channel at Alice/Bob boundary; q_total=q_ch+(1-2q_ch)*q_gate; constant total QBER isolates composition

diagnostic.design_optimization: Fisher-information minimax variance across p=.02,.03,.04 and r=0,.1,.2,.3,.4; two-point f in {2.5,4,6,8}, low-scale share in {.5,.6,.7,.8,.9}; calibration share selected on same grid, without empirical holdout errors
diagnostic.competitor: implement and attribute the exact interception-density formula from Fiorini source; score r/4 on the same counts; distinguish its readout-noise convention from this two-hop gate model

statistics.absolute_FER: Wilson 95% intervals and observed error counts
statistics.paired_tests: exact McNemar, Holm separately per predeclared comparison family
statistics.efficiency: f_syn=m/(n*h2(Q)); f_EC=(m+64)/(n*h2(Q)); Q is measured block QBER in aggregate reporting, target expectation for controlled curves
statistics.uncertainty: paired stratified frame/replicate bootstrap, 10000 resamples; holdout code choices frozen by calibration
